ops.newText:
20. INDEMNIFICATION
20.1 Vendor IP Indemnity. Vendor shall defend Customer, its Affiliates, and their personnel against any third-party claim that the Services, Deliverables, or Vendor Technology infringe or misappropriate any patent, copyright, trademark, or trade secret, and shall indemnify against resulting damages, settlements, and reasonable costs.
20.2 Vendor Other Indemnities. Vendor shall defend and indemnify Customer against third-party claims arising from (a) Vendor's breach of Sections 15, 16 or 17 or a Security Incident affecting Customer Data; (b) Vendor's violation of Applicable Law; (c) death, personal injury, or tangible property damage caused by Vendor; and (d) claims by Vendor personnel or subcontractors relating to their engagement.
20.3 Customer Indemnity. Customer shall defend and indemnify Vendor against third-party claims that Customer Data, as provided by Customer, infringes third-party IP or violates Applicable Law, except to the extent arising from Vendor's breach, negligence, or wilful misconduct.
20.4 Procedure. Prompt notice (delay excuses only to the extent of prejudice), indemnitor control of defence with reputable counsel, indemnitee right to participate at its own cost, no settlement imposing liability, admission, or non-monetary obligation on the indemnitee without consent.
20.5 Infringement Remedies. If a claim under 20.1 arises or is reasonably likely, Vendor shall at its expense (a) procure the right to continue use; or (b) modify or replace the item so it is non-infringing with materially equivalent functionality. If neither is achievable within thirty (30) days, either Party may terminate the affected Order Form and Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees plus, for perpetual/paid-up items, Fees paid depreciated on a five-year straight-line basis. Exclusions: no obligation to the extent infringement arises solely from Customer Data or Customer's unauthorised modification.
